description: This source file implements a utility program that interacts with POSIX message queues. It prompts the user for a process ID, constructs a message queue name based on that ID, opens the message queue, sends a 'leak_check' message, and then closes the queue.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program that interacts with POSIX message queues to send a 'leak_check' message based on user input.
